title: Sweet Sans / Dressing portion

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Make type variation legible through familiar language so viewers can feel how width and weight change a word’s voice.
strategic_value: The dressing-portion analogy can link Sweetgreen’s type family to its food experience.
demonstration: On a vivid yellow-green field, Light, Medium and Heavy replace one another in visibly different widths and weights; matching pill controls highlight the current option.
practical_value: Compare the family’s visual range while distinguishing this playful specimen from actual font-axis specifications.

content_islands.name: Portion controls
content_islands.spec: Place Dressing Portion and three option pills across the top.

content_islands.name: Type specimen
content_islands.spec: Set the current word large at mid-height, changing its width and weight.

content_islands.name: Family credit
content_islands.spec: Keep Sweet Sans and Type Family at opposite lower corners.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animated specimen connects light, medium and heavy lettering with dressing-portion labels.
reference_purposes.Application: Three successive words demonstrate contrasting appearances within the named Sweet Sans family.

ingredient.name: Sweet Sans variation
ingredient.role: Give words different degrees of emphasis and presence.
ingredient.application: Compare the light condensed, medium and heavy broad specimens when choosing a typographic voice.
ingredient.scope: Demonstrated specimen only; the clip does not supply font-axis coordinates, a full style inventory or required pairings.
